about:
# Level Thumbnails

**Level Thumbnails** is a mod that adds thumbnails to levels in search.

## Thumbnail Submission

To submit thumbnails, go to **settings** and toggle "In-Game Thumbnail Taking."
Then take a thumbnail using the **Level Thumbnails** button in the **pause menu**.

### Checking your submission status:
1. Please go onto https://levelthumbs.prevter.me/ and log in with your **Discord** account.
2. Head to the settings *(on the website)* and copy your link token from the form displayed.
3. Open **Level Thumbnails** settings in the **Geode UI** and head to the option where it says "Link Account".
4. Paste the token you have just copied and press **Link**.
5. Go back on the website and refresh the page, you may now use the **Dashboard** and **My Thumbnails** tabs to see useful information about your prior submissions and **rejections**.

# Credits

- Logo & initial mod idea by [BriftXD (Twitter)](https://twitter.com/BriftXD)
- Placeholder on the Thumbnail popup by [Cvolton (Twitter)](https://twitter.com/Misabr0penguin)
- Thanks to [Alphalaneous (GitHub)](https://github.com/Alphalaneous) for fixing a lot of my bad code :3
- [Matcool (GitHub)](https://github.com/matcool) for letting me steal a little bit of his [pinch to zoom](https://github.com/HJfod/BetterEdit/blob/v6/src/features/PinchToZoom.cpp) code
- Submission rules displayed in game written by [LooferGD (YouTube)](https://www.youtube.com/@LooferGD)
- Server programming and hosting done by [Prevter (Website)](https://prevter.me)

- Made messages about "Low Detail Mode" more clear.
- Added integration with Eclipse Menu to check for infringing hacks (and auto disable some of them).
- Implemented a way to block taking thumbnails when certain mods are detected dynamically.
- Added a check for GDPS submissions.
